title: Production Reliability and Monitoring knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Input validation” in this lesson?
options: This topic removes the need to validate inputs or inspect model outputs.
This topic guarantees identical results across all devices and package versions.
This topic makes every serialized checkpoint safe to load from an unknown source.
Choose a metric that matches the task, compute it on the intended split, and inspect representative errors before interpreting one aggregate score.
questions.answer_key: Choose a metric that matches the task, compute it on the intended split, and inspect representative errors before interpreting one aggregate score.
questions.explanation: Input validation: Choose a metric that matches the task, compute it on the intended split, and inspect representative errors before interpreting one aggregate score.

questions.prompt: Before relying on “Inference-time metrics”, what should a learner verify?
options: Use the held-out test split repeatedly to tune the model and report that score as unbiased.
Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
confirm dependency versions, input/error behavior, reproducibility records, quality metrics, and a recovery plan for failures or upgrades.
Assume all tensor dimensions and devices are interchangeable without checking them.
questions.answer_key: confirm dependency versions, input/error behavior, reproducibility records, quality metrics, and a recovery plan for failures or upgrades.
questions.explanation: This lesson recommends the following check: confirm dependency versions, input/error behavior, reproducibility records, quality metrics, and a recovery plan for failures or upgrades.

questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Performance and resource monitoring”?
options: Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
Do not claim a production deployment or performance gain without target-environment tests, monitoring, and documented limitations.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
questions.answer_key: Do not claim a production deployment or performance gain without target-environment tests, monitoring, and documented limitations.
questions.explanation: This topic-specific caution is important: Do not claim a production deployment or performance gain without target-environment tests, monitoring, and documented limitations.
